verdict.rationale: Missive documents a command bar opened with ⌘/Ctrl + K that runs actions such as snooze and supports quick search patterns. One community user calls it a "proper snappy desktop app." However, there is no evidence of a comprehensive shortcut set or that everything can be done from the keyboard, and a user reports that the snooze shortcut behaves inconsistently between private and team email. Missing for 10: a documented comprehensive keyboard-shortcut reference, evidence of full keyboard-only coverage, and performance evidence beyond one anecdote.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: or by opening the command bar with ⌘/Ctrl + K and typing "snooze".
Master the command bar: keyboard shortcuts and quick commands.
Missive feels like a proper snappy desktop app
